# Lean WebAssembly runtime

The runtime artifact is built by [cauli/lean4](https://github.com/cauli/lean4), a fork of [leanprover/lean4](https://github.com/leanprover/lean4). Exact commits and artifact SHA-256 checksums are pinned in `runtime/release.json`.

Runtime initialization is informed by [cauli/lean4-wasm-in-browser](https://github.com/cauli/lean4-wasm-in-browser), licensed under Apache-2.0. A copy of that license accompanies this notice. Lean itself is Apache-2.0 licensed. The downloaded artifact also includes upstream runtime components and their applicable licenses.

Lean Lab's teaching content is original. It is inspired by the official Functional Programming in Lean and Theorem Proving in Lean books, linked in the app.
